description: All links on a page, absolute, de-duplicated, split into internal and external. Fetches a page and returns every <a href> as an absolute URL with its anchor text and rel, de-duplicated, marked internal or external (same registrable host), plus counts of nofollow links, mailto/tel links and images. Price: $0.008 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
